text:
maddie_marketing: Hey team — proposing a small PLG pilot for the upcoming workshop launch. Goal: boost activation (first successful prompt completion) and on-ramp flow. Plan below, would love quick takes by EOD. :rocket:

maddie_marketing: TL;DR
- 2k free credits reserved for workshop signups
- Prompt-template pack (4 templates: summarizer, rewriting, ideation, code assist) delivered at signup
- 3 onboarding nudges over 7 days (email + in-console toast + in-app prompt challenge)
- Split test: control (no credits) vs credits-only vs credits+templates+nudges

leo_growth: love it. quick q: how are we routing inbound leads to the pilot vs general funnel? any qualification?

maddie_marketing: good call — routing plan: tag workshop signups with cohort=workshop-pilot and route to experiment. no manual qualify. threshold: first 2k signups or 30 days, whichever first.

anya_product: metric suite? what is primary signal and success criteria?

maddie_marketing: primary = % of cohort that completes a prompt template successfully within 7 days (event: prompt.execute with template_id). secondary = 7-day retention (any API call), time-to-first-successful-prompt, avg tokens used. success threshold: +6pp uplift vs control on prompt success.

nina_analytics: can track. will need event hooks + a clean funnel from signup -> template delivered -> prompt.execute. request: add experiment_id tag to all events.

sam_design: quick note on UX for the prompt pack — suggest a modal on first login that highlights 3 templates with one-click try. simple CTA: "Try template". I'll mock and share by tomorrow. :art:

leo_growth: sample allocation? I assume 20/40/40? or better to 33/33/33? we need power to detect 6pp.

nina_analytics: given expected baseline ~18% success, to detect +6pp with 80% power we need ~1700 users per arm. if you're capping at 2k total we should do 33/33/33 is tight. propose: 25% control / 37.5% credits-only / 37.5% full. or increase budget to 3k credits if marketing can.

maddie_marketing: ok — can we do dynamic cap: open to first 3k or 30 days. i'll push up to 3k credits if finance signs off.

anya_product: routing to webinar follow-ups: if a workshop attendee signs up but doesn't use templates within 48h, schedule an automated demo invite (soft), and a targeted micro-webinar invite. keep messaging light.

sam_design: messaging snippets (copy) for the modal and emails: short friendly copy + 1 micro-example for each template. will drop copy in the doc.

maddie_marketing: draft copy link: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/experiment-spark-pilot (WIP)

leo_growth: what about prompt templates — we should include a quick in-console example for product-market fit signals: a small checkbox: "share anonymized prompt use for research" — toggle opt-in.

nina_analytics: note: privacy ok w/ opt-in. but make sure we tag anonymized_use = true/false.

eng_ops_bot: experiment created: exp.sparkwksp.4990012345 | cohorts: control/credit/credit+pack | allocation: 25/37.5/37.5 | tracking tag: experiment_id=exp.sparkwksp.4990012345

maddie_marketing: perfect, thanks bot. action items:
- maddie: confirm final budget and update doc (today)
- sam: modal + email copy (tomorrow noon)
- anya: auto follow-up rules for 48h non-use (ETA Wed)
- nina: tracking dashboard + power calc + SQL cohorts (ETA Wed)
- leo: outreach plan for top 200 signups (manual touch)

leo_growth: :thumbsup: will prep outreach list and a short 1-liner for manual reachouts.

nina_analytics: I'll post the basic dashboard link once events are flowing.

maddie_marketing: thanks all. if no objections i'll greenlight tomorrow morning. keep thread light — ping me with blockers. :seedling:
